dialog.english:
He's been stuck like this for 300
years, ribbit. Ever since he lost
a karaoke match, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Lleva 300 años así, croac.
Perdió un karaoke, croac.

dialog.english:
To wake up, he needs to hear a
singing voice more beautiful than
the one that defeated him, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Para despertar necesita oír una
voz más bella que la que le
venció, croac.

dialog.english:
I see...Come to think of it, I
recently saw a girl who's an
amazing singer.
dialog.translation:
Ya veo...Por cierto, hace poco vi
a una chica que canta genial.

dialog.english:
I don't wanna hang in there! I
wanna drink water and eat and take
a bath!
dialog.translation:
¡No quiero aguantar! ¡Quiero beber
agua, comer y bañarme!

dialog.english:
Is thish the amazing shinger,
tama?

Please-ribbit... we want you to
cure our lord, ribbit!
dialog.translation:
¡Por favor, croac...
cura a nuestro amo, croac!

dialog.english:
We require a beautiful shinging
voice to awaken our lord, tama!
dialog.translation:
¡Necesitamos una voz hermoza que
despierte a nuestro señor, tama!

dialog.english:
Yes, ribbit! We were told that
you're an amazing singer, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
¡Sí, croac! Nos dijeron que eres
una cantante increíble, croac.

dialog.english:
We would very much like for you to
come to the castle, tama!
dialog.translation:
¡Nos encantaría que vinieras al
castillo, tama!

dialog.english:
Mimi, it looks like they're in
trouble. Should we help them?
dialog.translation:
Mimi, parece que tienen un
problema. ¿Les ayudamos?

dialog.english:
But like I said, I can't walk
anymore!
dialog.translation:
¡Pero ya dije que no puedo
caminar más!

dialog.english:
That's a shame, ribbit. We were
gonna offer you our best 
hospitality, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Qué pena, croac. Íbamos a darte
nuestra mejor hospitalidad,
croac.

dialog.english:
We even got a fluffy bed ready,
tama...

Really?! That does it! I'll go to
the castle!

Heeheeheehee...now the Crest of
Purity will never glow.
dialog.translation:
Jijijiji...ahora el Emblema
de la Pureza jamás brillará.

dialog.english: So, we're counting on you, ribbit!
We'll be waiting for you, tama!

All right, then, let's get psyched
up and go!
You really did come to help, tama!

Wow, it was a lot further than I
thought.
dialog.translation:
Vaya, estaba más lejos de lo
que pensaba.

dialog.english:
I definitely wanna rest for a
bit...

No doubt about it, there's someone
here! Let's keep going.

A frog and a tadpole? What's going
on?
dialog.translation:
¿Una rana y un renacuajo? ¿Qué
pasa aquí?

dialog.english:
We'll tell you more in the castle,
ribbit. Come inside, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Os lo contamos dentro del
castillo, croac. Entrad, croac.

dialog.english:
I see, you're trying to cure your
lord, but the girl's causing you
trouble instead.
dialog.translation:
Ya veo, queréis curar a vuestro
señor, pero la chica os está
dando problemas.

dialog.english:
As soon as you hear the princess
saying she wants mixed fried
rice...
dialog.translation:
En cuanto oímos que la princesa
quiere arroz frito mixto...

dialog.english:
...the next minute she shays she
wants a polka-dot dressh, tama.
dialog.translation:
...y al rato dice que quiere
un veztido de lunares, tama.

dialog.english:
A princess driving her servants
this crazy, huh.
dialog.translation:
Una princesa que trae locos
a sus sirvientes.

dialog.english: She must be a really selfish girl.

What? Can't you see? I'm being a
princess!
All right, let's hurry up and go!
Huuuuuuh? Why do I have to go?

We can't guarantee that we can go
back to our world, so why should I
put myself in danger?
dialog.translation:
No hay garantías de volver a
nuestro mundo, así que ¿por qué
debería arriesgarme?

dialog.english:
I've got everything here! A bath,
a fluffy bed, food!
dialog.translation:
¡Aquí tengo de todo! ¡Baño,
cama mullida, comida!

dialog.english: Palmon, go and set her straight!

If you don't have any other
business, leave! Here, escort
these people out!
dialog.translation:
¡Si no tenéis nada más que
hacer, marchaos! ¡Escoltad
a esta gente fuera!

dialog.english:
Anyway, what on earth happened to
Mimi?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, ¿qué demonios le pasó
a Mimi?

dialog.english:
She's gotten the wrong idea in her
head because of how much those
frogs are spoiling her!
dialog.translation:
¡Se le ha subido a la cabeza de
tanto que esas ranas la
consienten!

dialog.english:
We can't disobey the prinshess,
tama.
dialog.translation:
No desobedecemos a la
princeza, tama.

dialog.english:
I know you've got a major problem,
but you can't solve it by just
playing along.
dialog.translation:
Sé que tenéis un problema
grave, pero no se arregla
solo con seguir la corriente.

dialog.english: Ah, well. So, what do we do now?

Doesn't seem like Mimi plans to
help your lord out.
dialog.translation:
No parece que Mimi vaya a
ayudar a vuestro señor.

dialog.english:
It might be easier if we just get
him to listen to her song.
dialog.translation:
Sería más fácil que él la
oyera cantar sin más.

dialog.english:
Ah! We'll bug Mimi's room with
recording equipment and record her
song!
dialog.translation:
¡Pondremos micros en el cuarto
de Mimi y grabaremos su
canción!

dialog.english:
But how are we going to get into
Mimi's room without her noticing?
dialog.translation:
¿Pero cómo entramos en su
cuarto sin que se dé cuenta?

dialog.english:
There's an emergency passage
underneath the hallway that leads
into her room, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Hay un pasadizo de emergencia
bajo el pasillo que lleva a su
cuarto, croac.

dialog.english:
Then we have to get a recording
device, but...

Long ago, our lord bought one to
practice karaoke. It's in the
underground shtoreroom, tama.
dialog.translation:
Hace tiempo compró una para
practicar karaoke. Está en
el almazén subterráneo, tama.

dialog.english:
We'll find a way to pull this off,
Tai!

Yeah! Otamamon, Gekomon, can you
guide us through the passage?
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! Otamamon, Gekomon, ¿nos
guiáis por el pasadizo?

dialog.english:
But there are elite troops in the
underground passage who adore the
prinshess, tama.
dialog.translation:
Pero hay tropas de élite en
el pasadizo que adoran a la
princeza, tama.

dialog.english: All right, we can use this!

All right, let's head to Mimi's
room!
Go wait in the next room, ribbit!
We'll leave the rest to you!

*yawn* This castle is comfy, but
I'm bored.

If you're bored, would you like to
do some karaoke?
dialog.translation:
Si os aburrís, ¿os apetece
hacer karaoke?

dialog.english: I don't really feel like it.

Oh, no! I want to hear the
princess singing, ribbit!
dialog.translation:
¡Oh, no! ¡Quiero oír cantar
a la princesa, croac!

dialog.english: It was a wonderful song, tama!
She's singing! We can do this!

I had a feeling you'd think up
something like this!
dialog.translation:
¡Sabía que se os ocurriría
algo así!

dialog.english: Keep them in there. Got it?

What happened to the kind Mimi
that I knew? If you're going to be
like this, I hate you!
dialog.translation:
¿Qué le pasó a la Mimi buena
que yo conocía? ¡Si vas a ser
así, te odio!

dialog.english: Okay, then! I hate you, too!

Ugh! I can't believe how
everyone's acting. To think that
even Palmon would say that!
dialog.translation:
¡Uf! No puedo creer cómo se
está comportando todo el
mundo. ¡Hasta Palmon dijo eso!

dialog.english:
Why does everyone want to take me
with them on their journey?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué todos quieren
llevarme con ellos de viaje?

dialog.english:
I'm sick of all these scary
things...
dialog.translation:
Estoy harta de cosas que dan
miedo...

dialog.english:
You already know what you're doing
wrong, and what you should be
doing instead, right?
dialog.translation:
Ya sabes que lo estás haciendo
mal, y sabes qué deberías
hacer en su lugar, ¿verdad?

dialog.english:
So you already know what to do
right now, right?
dialog.translation:
Entonces ya sabes qué hacer
ahora, ¿no?

dialog.english:
Good. You really are a good girl,
Mimi.
dialog.translation:
Bien. Eres una buena chica,
Mimi.

dialog.english: you really are a good girl, Mimi.

Listen up, everyone. I'm going to
sing.

All the Gekomon and Otamamon.
Tai, Joe, Agumon and Gomamon...
dialog.translation:
Todos los Gekomon y Otamamon.
Tai, Joe, Agumon y Gomamon...

dialog.english: My apologies may not be enough.

But I'm aware that I've treated
everyone horribly! So...
dialog.translation:
¡Pero sé que os he tratado
fatal a todos! Así que...

dialog.english:
I want to hear the princess's
singing!

And I was sleeping so well! Who
woke me up, ribbit?!
dialog.translation:
¡Dormía tan bien! ¡¿Quién me ha
despertado, croac?!

dialog.english:
We didn't know the lord was
actually a tyrant!
dialog.translation:
¡No sabíamos que el señor era
un tirano!

dialog.english:
Gh... please forgive me, ribbit! I
won't go crazy twice, ribbit!
*cough*

I won't go crazy twice, ribbit!
*cough*

Go to sleep for the rest of your
life!

The Crest of Purity has regained
its power once again. Please,
forgive me...
dialog.translation:
El Emblema de la Pureza ha
recuperado su poder. Por
favor, perdonadme...

dialog.english:
In that case, I'll have to go
visit them in person.
dialog.translation:
En ese caso, tendré que ir
a verlos yo mismo.

dialog.english:
Tai, the Digivice reaction
isn't coming from that direction!
dialog.translation:
Tai, ¡el dispositivo no
reacciona en esa dirección!

dialog.english:
Tai, we're looking for the
recording device!

Tai, Mimi's room isn't that
way!
dialog.translation:
Tai, ¡el cuarto de Mimi
no está ahí!

dialog.english:
Are we *still* not at the castle
yet?

I'm sure it's just a bit farther!
Keep going!

Wow, it's kind of dark and damp in
here...
dialog.translation:
Vaya, está oscuro y húmedo
aquí...

dialog.english: Is it? I don't really mind.

Come on, let's find the recording
device and hurry to Mimi's room!
dialog.translation:
¡Vamos, busquemos la grabadora
y corramos al cuarto de Mimi!

dialog.english:
Aaaaaaaah, are we gonna be trapped
here forever?

Maybe... for the rest of our
lives?!
Are we going to die here?!
Honestly, it's about time to eat!

Mimi's eating delicious food right
now, isn't she?
dialog.translation:
Mimi estará comiendo algo
rico ahora mismo, ¿no?

dialog.english: I give up on talking to her!

It was bad enough getting to this
castle, but being put in jail is
another matter!
dialog.translation:
¡Ya fue difícil llegar al
castillo, pero que nos metan
en la cárcel es otra cosa!

dialog.english:
I wonder what everyone else is
doing around now?
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto qué estarán
haciendo los demás ahora.

dialog.english:
I bet at least we're the only ones
locked up in prison.
dialog.translation:
Al menos seremos los únicos
en la cárcel, seguro.
